alt: Key concepts change, relationships and systems, with related concepts such as energy, movement, transformation and models, explored through six global contexts. Work is assessed on four equally weighted criteria: A knowing and understanding, B inquiring and designing, C processing and evaluating and D reflecting on the impacts of science, each scored 0 to 8 for a total of 0 to 32.
caption: Concepts and contexts frame the work; four criteria, each 0 to 8, assess it.

alt: A bar of 100 marks: knowing and understanding, criterion A, 25 marks; investigation skills, criteria B and C, 50 marks; applying science, criterion D, 25 marks. The on-screen examination is available in biology, chemistry, physics and integrated sciences.
caption: Investigation skills carry half of the 100 marks.
